description: Fix an AI-generated PNG for use in a game: removes a fake transparent background (the grey and white checkerboard painted into the pixels) or a flat background colour, cleans the coloured fringe around edges, deletes stray specks and trims to the content. Also cleans the edges of images that already have real transparency.

force.description: Remove the border colour even when no background was detected.

frame.description: trim to the content, keep the original size, or trim and pad to a square.

image_base64.description: The PNG file as base64 (a data: URL also works). Use instead of image_url.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG image, up to about 128×128 pixels.

name.description: Short name for the output files.

pad.description: Transparent pixels to add around the result.

tolerance.description: How far a colour can be from the background and still be removed. Default 34 for a checkerboard, 40 for a solid colour.

name: fix_ai_png
title: Fix AI PNG background
